completeness.why: Each provider keeps only its bank lookup (declared not a copy) and passes its own data to linkBankSyncAccount, which owns upgrade-or-insert, transfer payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and the sync event; the preserved differences are explicit arguments (fileId for Pluggy.ai, syncedTables for Akahu, newAccountFields for GoCardless's mask/official name).

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variations and the inconsistencies are explicit, but newAccountFields is an untyped Record<string, unknown> that loses column typing, and syncedTables is a free string[] rather than a named variation.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies of the link sequence are removed and replaced by calls; only the per-provider bank lookups remain, which are provider-specific.
